Ler textos curtos em russo com estratégi: Read short Russian texts using strategies (read the title and key sentences, find the source, cause and sequence, work out words from the root and from context) and answer comprehension questions.
Como ler em russo sem ter medo das palav: How to read Russian without fearing new words
PASSO 1: leia primeiro o TÍTULO e a prim: STEP 1: read the TITLE and the first sentence first: they give the topic. STEP 2: look for the KEY SENTENCES: the subject, the verb and the tense («Анна проснулась», «идёт дождь»). STEP 3: mark the CONNECTORS: «потому что, поэтому, хотя, благодаря» show cause and contrast. STEP 4: identify the SEQUENCE through gerunds and time adverbs: «Выйдя из дома…», «Придя на работу…». STEP 5: for a new word, look at the ROOT and the PREFIX: «учить, учитель, учебник» share «уч-». STEP 6: use the CONTEXT: what makes sense there? STEP 7: do NOT stop at every unknown word: keep going and come back later. STEP 8: after reading, RETELL: who did what, where, when and why. English readers can use the same skills, but in Russian the ROOT is especially helpful, because families of words are built around it.
Qual é a causa? Há contraste?: What is the cause? Is there a contrast?
Que palavra conhecida está dentro desta?: What known word is inside this one?
Diga em voz alta os 6 passos da leitura: Say the 6 reading steps out loud and give an example of each with a Russian sentence.
Escreva 5 frases sobre uma festa e uma t: Write 5 sentences about a holiday and a tradition.
Anna acordou às sete horas. Ao sair de c: Anna woke up at seven o'clock. When she left the house, she saw that it was raining. Although she had no umbrella, she decided to walk, because she did not want to be late. When she arrived at work, Anna realized that she had forgotten her keys. Luckily, a colleague who had arrived earlier opened the door for her. Anna smiled and said: «Thanks to you, I made it on time!»
PASSO 1: veja a SEQUÊNCIA com gerúndios:: STEP 1: see the SEQUENCE with gerunds: «Выйдя…, она увидела», «Придя…, Анна поняла». STEP 2: see the CAUSE: «потому что не хотела опоздать». STEP 3: see the CONTRAST: «Хотя у неё не было зонта». STEP 4: see the RELATIVE CLAUSE: «коллега, который пришёл раньше». STEP 5: see the thanks: «Благодаря тебе».

Releia as estratégias de leitura e diga-: Reread the reading strategies and say them from memory.
Как выучить язык / Como aprender uma lín: Как выучить язык / How to learn a language
Quanto mais você lê, melhor entende. Pri: The more you read, the better you understand. First read simple texts and then difficult ones. If you do not understand a word, do not stop: try to work out the meaning from the context. In addition, it is useful to listen to the radio and talk with native speakers. The main thing is to study every day, even if only for half an hour.
Os recursos do texto de dicas: The devices of a tips text
PASSO 1: veja «чем … тем …»: «Чем больше: STEP 1: see «чем … тем …»: «Чем больше читаете, тем лучше понимаете». STEP 2: see the imperative of «вы»: «читайте, не останавливайтесь, попробуйте». STEP 3: see the order: «сначала… затем…». STEP 4: see the addition: «кроме того». STEP 5: see «пусть даже» (even if).
